disasters.summary: Super Typhoon In-fa (Typhoon No. 31) began on 23 October 2026 and is over the open western Pacific, not on land. As of 3 a.m. on 30 October it was near Minamitorishima Island. The Japan Meteorological Agency classified it as a very strong typhoon on 30 October, with maximum sustained winds near 162 km/h. It is forecast to move west toward the Ogasawara Islands around 31 October. No land impacts have been reported.

disasters.summary: Cyclone Arnab made landfall on the Andhra Pradesh coast near Narsapur, West Godavari district, on 28 October 2026. It weakened into a deep depression on 29 October and may become a low-pressure area. Rain and wind warnings for Odisha, West Bengal and Telangana run to 29 October. Sources report 3 to 5 deaths; the state has not issued a consolidated toll. Relief work is under way and the central assessment is pending.

disasters.summary: Drought has affected crops, river levels and water supply across much of Europe in 2026. A JRC bulletin dated 23 October 2026 reported persistently low soil moisture in western, central and south-eastern Europe, hampering rapeseed emergence.
